verdict.rationale: Otter documents automatic extraction of action items with owners/assignees from meetings, and provides multiple ways to track them (synced to CRM, sent to JIRA/Asana/ClickUp, organized in Channels, searchable via AI Chat/MCP). Community evidence corroborates general transcription/summary quality but does not contradict action-item extraction specifically. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that owner-assignment accuracy is reliable, and no direct third-party review of the action-item tracking workflow itself.
